abstract: The relationship of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) to parental age was evaluated in a case-control study of 132 women with hydatidiform mole (108) or choriocarcinoma (24) and 304 control subjects hospitalized for normal deliveries. Cases and controls were recruited in Lombardy (Northern Italy), and all were white and Italian. Compared to the risk of developing trophoblastic tumors in women 21-35 years old, the risk of developing trophoblastic tumors was elevated both in younger [less than or equal to 20 yr old, relative risk (RR) = 1.4, with 95% confidence interval (Cl) of 0.7-2.8] and in older subjects, RR being 1.2 (95% Cl 0.7-2.8) and 5.2 (95% Cl 2.2-12.3) for women 36-40 years old and over 40, respectively. The risk estimates for the last two categories were reduced to 0.7 (with 95% Cl of 0.3-1.9) and 2.5 (with 95% Cl of 0.7-8.9) when adjustment was made for paternal age by means of the Mantel-Haenszel procedure. Higher paternal age also was associated with GTD: Women whose husbands were 41-45 years old and over 45 had RR of 1.6 (with 95% Cl = 0.7-3.7) and 4.9 (with 95% Cl = 2.2-11.1), respectively, compared to women married to men less than 40 years old. These risk estimates were practically unchanged when adjustment was made for the woman's age. Examination of the effects of parental and maternal ages suggests that the highest risk estimate was observed when both parents were older. The findings of the present study were consistent with increased risk in the youngest maternal age group and confirm that older maternal age is associated with increased risk of GTD. Furthermore, showing a strong, independent effect of paternal age, they give epidemiologic support to the cytogenetic evidence of an androgenetic role in the origin of GTD.
abstract_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)と父母の年齢との関連を、ロンバルディア州(北イタリア)で行われた症例対照研究で評価した。対象は、胞状奇胎(108例)または絨毛癌(24例)の女性132例と、正常分娩で入院した対照304例である。全員が白人のイタリア人であった。21~35歳の女性と比較した相対リスクは、20歳以下で1.4(95%CI 0.7~2.8)、36~40歳で1.2(95%CI 0.7~2.8)、40歳超で5.2(95%CI 2.2~12.3)であった。父親の年齢で補正すると、後者2区分のリスク推定値はそれぞれ0.7(95%CI 0.3~1.9)、2.5(95%CI 0.7~8.9)に低下した。父親が41~45歳、45歳超の場合の相対リスクは、40歳未満の男性の妻と比較してそれぞれ1.6(95%CI 0.7~3.7)、4.9(95%CI 2.2~11.1)であった。母親の年齢で補正しても、これらのリスク推定値はほとんど変わらなかった。母体と父体の年齢の効果を検討した結果、両親ともに高齢の場合に最もリスク推定値が高かった。本研究の結果は、母体年齢が最も若い群でリスクが高いことと一致し、高齢の母体年齢が妊娠性絨毛性疾患のリスク増加と関連することを確認した。さらに、父親年齢が母体年齢とは独立して強い効果を示したことは、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の起源における雄核発生の役割を示す細胞遺伝学的証拠を裏付けるものである。
